en: A black-and-white postcard showing a scenic panorama of a European town nestled in a valley, with hills in the background and tree branches partially framing the top of the image. The caption at the bottom reads 'Blick auf Bad Pyrmont.' The back side contains handwritten German text, a green Deutsche Reich postage stamp, postmark, and a museum stamp 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT.'
